name: lkep_status_shared_ref
structural_change: Existing32bit replay-count capture and identical modulo32 sum in separate own-clock small leaf on same original edge, local async-assert/twoFFsync/region-copy reset same cold release edge. No packet/credit/data/reset epoch change. Parent17 clock entries explicit; native parent wire/context/clock assignment unapproved. Actual full-peer comparator includes status counters on everyedge, and a nonzero actual replay-count mutation must fail.
